scope: Observed-state replay and numeric-input Train screening; neither passes its registered gate. No new policy adoption, no Dev or Test evaluation.

encoded.scope: Source-held Train screening of measured continuation replay, with frozen parent follow-up actions. Not an independent policy effectiveness evaluation.

plan.selection: Same inherited value head, same frozen constructor/GRU, same actual future response draws. Compare historical supervised starting states with all measured continuation states, selected only by observed identity. Both conditions use the same gradient-update budget and common source-held Train states; select epochs by equal-benchmark, equal-family sampled remaining-loss targets. The frozen encoder has previously seen these Train sources; this is an inner screening, not independent effectiveness.
plan.gates: All three continuation seeds must strictly improve common held-Train target loss over observed-only, not worsen either benchmark relative to the inherited head, and not increase expected false handoffs. Only then perform an independently sampled actual sequential Train check; full refit and fixed Dev evaluation follow only if that passes. No Test or frozen 27-source holdout inference.
plan.arithmetic: Use existing FP32 actionPrecision for exact cached-head consistency in both arms; encoder and other heads remain unchanged. Preserve original selected inference bundle and weights until all adoption gates pass.
plan.interpretation: Synthetic/controlled manager replies and documents; actual observed sales for retail loss. Sampled target loss with fixed parent continuation is not new-policy rollout loss or a true optimum.

numeric.scope: Source-held Train screening of the existing numeric-state path with corrected observed response states. Frozen parent continuation targets; not new-policy effectiveness.

plan.scope: Same 1204 actual own-state Train states, same 11044 measured continuation rollouts, source split and optimizer update budget. Use the existing 94 numeric state features, with inherited first 256 head columns and zero new columns. Verify initial predictions on every state before training. No new environment samples or encoder training.
plan.hypothesis: Explicit availability updates leave selected text tokens unchanged in six retail failure states; numeric inputs preserve this distinction. This known input-path limitation does not alone establish causation; test it with the newly corrected observed states and measured continuation replay.
plan.gates: All three numeric continuation seeds must improve the encoded continuation target loss, be no worse than numeric observed-only on the common held-Train criterion, preserve each benchmark relative to the parent and not increase expected false handoffs. Only then perform an independently sampled sequential Train check before full refit and preregistered Dev validation. Otherwise retain forecast-v1 and stop this candidate.
plan.interpretation: Train inner screen under finite parent-continuation returns, not a true optimum or policy rollout performance. Controlled response environment and documents, not organizational efficacy.

coverage.scope: Historical Train collection versus all measured continuation states; no new inference or outcome selection

targetAudit.scope: Every finite sampled action target checked against its actual parent-continuation rollout, not an optimum or new-policy loss.

residuals.scope: Diagnostic of finite parent-continuation return targets on inner held Train states; no independent policy rollout or optimality claim.

visibility.scope: Train-only input-path intervention on explicit constructed availability. The observed history is held fixed, so this does not prove all no-response information is absent or establish a cause of policy loss.

complementary.scope: native component diagnostics, not an end-to-end order benchmark

core-retail-train-v1.scope: Frozen complementary snapshot plus source-disjoint original Train sales; no latent demand or organizational efficacy claim

core-tatqa-train-v1.scope: Frozen complementary snapshot plus original Train financial-document annotations; no organizational efficacy claim

core-retail-holdout-v1.scope: Existing inputs unchanged plus frozen unseen-source evaluation; original public Train split reused only for previously unused sources, not model training

core-retail-linked-v1.scope: Original snapshots unchanged; extra observations within existing Train source families

publishedReproduction.scope: Verify the published cached-head Train screen; this does not rerun the encoder or policy.
publishedReproduction.scopeNote: Only cached features and small heads; no original datasets, checkpoint, encoder execution or fresh sequential policy evaluation.
